questions.stem: What is the main reason that a shadow is formed?
choices: Light is absorbed by the object
Light is reflected by the object
Light is scattered by the object
Light is blocked by the object
questions.solution: The correct answer is 'Light is blocked by the object' because a shadow is formed when an object obstructs the path of light. This prevents the light from reaching the surface behind the object, creating a dark area.

hi.stem: छाया बनने का मुख्य कारण क्या है?

hi.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses standard Hindi scientific terminology.

questions.stem: What is the main reason why an image formed by a plane mirror cannot be obtained on a screen?
questions.solution: The image formed by a plane mirror is virtual, meaning it cannot be projected onto a screen because the light rays do not actually converge at the image location. A virtual image is formed by the apparent intersection of diverging light rays, which cannot be captured on a physical surface. The other options—size, brightness, and inversion—do not affect whether an image can be projected onto a screen.

questions.stem: A student places a pencil in front of a plane mirror. The image of the pencil in the mirror is the same size as the pencil. What can be concluded about the image formed by a plane mirror?
choices: The image is always smaller than the object
The image is always larger than the object
The image is the same size as the object
questions.solution: The image formed by a plane mirror is the same size as the object because the mirror reflects light in a way that preserves the object's dimensions. This is a fundamental property of plane mirrors, which produce virtual images that are not magnified or reduced. The other options are incorrect because plane mirrors do not invert images, nor do they make them larger or smaller than the actual object.

questions.stem: A student creates a pinhole camera and observes the image of a tree on the screen. What is the nature of the image formed?
questions.solution: The image formed by a pinhole camera is always inverted because light travels in straight lines and the top of the object is projected to the bottom of the screen and vice versa. The option 'erect' is incorrect because the image is not upright. The option 'erect and inverted' is incorrect because the image cannot be both. 'Cannot be determined' is also incorrect as the image nature is predictable based on the physics of light.

headingPath: 11.6 Images Formed in a Plane Mirror

questions.stem: A student looks at their image in a plane mirror. They raise their left hand, and the image raises its right hand. What is this phenomenon called?
questions.solution: Lateral inversion occurs when the left and right sides of an object are reversed in a mirror image, which is why raising the left hand makes the image appear to raise the right hand. Reflection refers to the general phenomenon of light bouncing off a surface, but it does not specifically describe the left-right reversal. Refraction is the bending of light as it passes through different mediums, and diffusion is the scattering of light in many directions, neither of which explain the mirror's effect.

hi.stem: एक छात्र समतल दर्पण में अपनी छाया को देखता है। वे अपना बायां हाथ उठाते हैं, और छाया अपना दायां हाथ उठाती है। इस घटना को क्या कहते हैं?

mr.solution: बाजूचे विरोध हा एखाद्या वस्तूच्या बाजूच्या बाजू आणि उजव्या बाजू दर्पणातील छायाचित्रात उलटलेल्या जातात, ज्यामुळे बाजूचा हात उचलल्यास छायाचित्रात उजवा हात उचलल्यासारखे दिसते. प्रतिबिंब हा प्रकाशाच्या एखाद्या सतही उरलेल्या सामान्य घटनेचा संदर्भ देतो, परंतु तो बाजूच्या बदलाचे विशिष्ट वर्णन करत नाही. अपवर्तन हा प्रकाशाचा विविध माध्यमांतून वाकलेल्या घटनेचा संदर्भ देतो, आणि विसरण हा प्रकाशाच्या अनेक दिशांमध्ये बिखरलेल्या घटनेचा संदर्भ देतो, जे दर्पणाच्या परिणामाचे वर्णन करत नाही.

headingPath: 11.6 Images Formed in a Plane Mirror

questions.stem: In a dark room, a torch is placed so that its light falls on a screen. A student holds a transparent object in front of the light. What will the student observe on the screen?
choices: The screen will be completely dark
The screen will show a bright spot
The screen will show a blurred image
The screen will show a shadow of the object
questions.solution: A transparent object allows light to pass through it. So, when a transparent object is held in front of the light, the light will still reach the screen, and a bright spot will be visible. A shadow is formed when an opaque object blocks light, and a blurred image or darkness would not happen with a transparent object.

hi.stem: अंधेरे कमरे में, एक सीढ़ी के रूप में रखा गया है जिसका प्रकाश स्क्रीन पर पड़ता है। एक छात्र एक पारदर्शी वस्तु को प्रकाश के सामने रखता है। छात्र स्क्रीन पर क्या देखेगा?
choices: स्क्रीन पूरी तरह अंधेरी हो जाएगी
hi.solution: एक पारदर्शी वस्तु प्रकाश के पार गुजरने की अनुमति देती है। इसलिए, जब एक पारदर्शी वस्तु को प्रकाश के सामने रखा जाता है, तो प्रकाश स्क्रीन तक पहुंचता रहता है, और एक चमकदार धब्बा दिखाई देता है। एक छाया तब बनती है जब अपारदर्शी वस्तु प्रकाश को रोकती है, और एक अस्पष्ट छाया या अंधेरा पारदर्शी वस्तु के साथ नहीं होता है।
hi.critique: Translation is accurate and maintains the scientific meaning. Technical terms like 'पारदर्शी' (transparent) and 'छाया' (shadow) are correctly used as per Hindi curriculum.

mr.stem: अंधारात एक टॉर्च असेल ज्याचा प्रकाश स्क्रीनवर पडत असेल. एका विद्यार्थीने प्रकाशाच्या दिशेत एक पारदर्शक वस्तू ठेवते. विद्यार्थीने स्क्रीनवर काय नोंद करेल?

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT a source of light?
questions.solution: A shining mirror is not a source of light. It only reflects light. A lit candle, a glowing bulb, and a shining star are all sources of light that emit their own light. A mirror does not emit light, so it is not a source of light.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन प्रकाश का स्रोत नहीं है?
hi.solution: चमकता हुआ दर्पण प्रकाश का स्रोत नहीं है। यह केवल प्रकाश को परावर्तित करता है। जलती हुई मोमबत्ती, चमकता हुआ बल्ब और चमकता हुआ तारा सभी प्रकाश के स्रोत हैं जो अपने आप अपना प्रकाश उत्सर्जित करते हैं। दर्पण प्रकाश उत्सर्जित नहीं करता है, इसलिए यह प्रकाश का स्रोत नहीं है।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation accurately reflects the English question and solution, with appropriate terminology used in a Hindi-medium educational context.
